annual.description: One value per year in 'years'. coffee_harvest_t_c_ha: Coffee beans harvested in the year (t C/ha); coffee_harvest_dm_kg_ha: Coffee beans harvested in the year (kg dry matter/ha), harvest C / CCONC; coffee_biomass_t_c_ha: Coffee biomass carbon at year end, C_f (t C/ha); tree_biomass_t_c_ha: Shade-tree biomass carbon at year end, all species, CT_f (t C/ha); tree_stem_t_c_ha_1: Stem carbon of tree species 1 at year end (t C/ha); _2, _3 likewise; tree_density_per_ha_1: Trees per ha of species 1 at year end; _2, _3 likewise; tree_height_m_1: Height of tree species 1 at year end (m); _2, _3 likewise; soil_c_t_ha: Soil organic carbon at year end, Csoil_f (t C/ha); soil_n_t_ha: Soil organic nitrogen at year end, Nsoil_f (t N/ha); system_c_t_ha: Coffee + trees + soil carbon at year end (t C/ha); n_fertiliser_kg_ha: Fertiliser N applied (kg N/ha/yr); n_fixation_kg_ha: N fixed by trees (kg N/ha/yr); n_leaching_kg_ha: N leached (kg N/ha/yr); n_emission_kg_ha: Gaseous N emission (kg N/ha/yr), Nemission_f; n_runoff_kg_ha: N lost in runoff (kg N/ha/yr); c_soil_respiration_t_ha: Soil respiration (t C/ha/yr); rain_mm: Rain (mm/yr); drainage_mm: Drainage (mm/yr); runoff_mm: Runoff (mm/yr); evaporation_mm: Soil evaporation (mm/yr); transpiration_coffee_mm: Coffee transpiration (mm/yr); transpiration_trees_mm: Tree transpiration (mm/yr); days: Simulated days in the year
annual.title: Annual

daily.description: Only when daily_variables is set: 'year' and 'doy' plus one list per variable (CAF units)
daily.title: Daily

first_day.description: year-doy of the first simulated day
first_day.title: First Day
